why: The criterion holds. I checked whether a build that breaks plain CSV input could still pass every expect line. It could not. One expect line says "Without the flag, CSV still works as before: `printf 'a,b\n1,2\n' | node bin/csv2json.js` prints exactly `[{"a":"1","b":"2"}]`". It has a run proof, so any change to comma parsing without the flag fails that line. A second line fixes the current no-flag output for tab input, which also catches a build that changes the default separator. The outcome adds "Running without the flag behaves exactly as it does today." Nothing else in the issue breaks the must_not item.
